Comments.AzureWebJobsStorage: Storage connection used by Functions runtime/triggers.
Comments.DEPLOYMENT_STORAGE_CONNECTION_STRING: Storage account connection string used for deployment artifacts or additional storage operations.
Comments.SERVICEBUS_CONNECTION: Service Bus connection for queue trigger and sender.
Comments.SERVICEBUS_JOBS_QUEUE: Queue name for job dispatch (must match trigger binding if overridden).
Comments.BLOB_CONNECTION: Blob Storage connection string used for upload/download.
Comments.BLOB_ACCOUNT_URL: Blob account URL used to build user delegation SAS links.
Comments.BLOB_OUTPUT_CONTAINER: Container name used for job outputs.
Comments.BLOB_INPUT_CONTAINER: Container name used for job input uploads.
Comments.SIGNALR_HUB_NAME: SignalR hub name used for realtime updates.
Comments.WORKER_DELAY_SECONDS: Optional delay (in seconds) before worker transitions to processing state (useful for demos/testing).
Comments.FRONTEND_API_BASE_URL: Frontend API base URL injected into client runtime configuration.
Comments.AZURE_AD_TENANT_ID: Azure AD tenant identifier used for authentication and token validation.
Comments.AZURE_AD_API_AUDIENCE: Expected audience (Application ID URI) of incoming access tokens for backend validation.
Comments.AZURE_AD_CLIENT_ID: Azure AD app registration client ID used by the frontend for MSAL authentication.
Comments.AZURE_AD_API_SCOPE: OAuth2 scope requested by the frontend to access the backend API (must match 'Expose an API' configuration).
Comments.AZURE_AD_AUTHORITY: Azure AD authority URL used to authenticate users against the specified tenant.
